_doc: The repos agentctl's red machine watches (the owner, 2026-10-30, ci-failures recommendation 4: infra's Stage NixOS closures was red 29 h and core's Main Pipeline 21 h with no fixer). One entry per Forgejo repo: `gate` its gate workflows ([name, file]: the newest decided run of each opens and clears its reds), `family` the red family every red of the repo belongs to (red-families.json says how it is held: one fixer per family), `push` `land` (its fixer lands with `agentctl land`) or `owner-only` (its fixer prepares the fix on a local branch and files the owner a one-liner with `agentctl red owner-push`; it never pushes or deploys: an infra push IS a deploy), `clone` the laptop's checkout fixers' worktrees branch from. The primary repo (movies) keeps everything it had: its gate stays GATING in lib/agentctl/ciwhy.py, its outside workflows, local checks and landing gate. $AGENTCTL_RED_REPOS names another file.
